errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос съдържа номерирани и текстови описания на стереотипите
errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart. The categories (numbered and textual descriptions of stereotypes) are on the vertical axis, not the horizontal axis.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос представлява процентната доля на отговорите, етикетирана с числови стойности
errors.evidence: The percentage values are represented by the length of the horizontal bars along the horizontal axis, not the vertical axis.

errors.text_span: като се използва азбучен ред по номера на стереотипите
errors.evidence: The stereotypes are ordered numerically by their number (7, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15), not alphabetically.

errors.text_span: скалата е линейна и се разполага в диапазон от 0 до 60, с интервали от 10
errors.evidence: The chart does not have a visible axis scale with intervals. The values are labeled directly at the end of each bar. Furthermore, the range is incorrect as the maximum value shown is 62.8.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете за всяка категория са разположени във вертикална линия
errors.evidence: This is an incorrect description of the grouped bar chart structure. For each category on the vertical axis, there is a group of three horizontal bars, not bars arranged in a 'vertical line'.

errors.text_span: сините стълби са най-високи за стереотипите 13 и 15, червените стълби са най-високи за стереотипите 10 и 12
errors.evidence: This sentence contains multiple factual errors. For stereotype 15, the red bar (53.3) is longer than the blue bar (34.9). For stereotype 10, the blue bar (50.9) is longer than the red bar (38.1). For stereotype 12, the blue bar (59.9) is longer than the red bar (34.1).

errors.text_span: Всяка категория е представена с различен цвят
errors.evidence: This is ambiguous. It's the response types ('Completely agree', etc.) that are color-coded, not the stereotype categories on the vertical axis. A clearer phrasing would specify that each response category from the legend has a different color.
